Reveal radiant, youthful skin with our comprehensive Advanced Skin Rejuvenation services at AestheticEye. Under the expert care of our licensed medical aesthetician, each treatment is designed to target specific skin concerns from fine lines and acne scars to dullness and uneven texture using the latest technology and medical-grade techniques. Patients from Cincinnati, Dayton, and surrounding communities trust our team for noticeable, natural-looking results.

Our Advanced Skin Rejuvenation Treatments

Explore a selection of medical-grade treatments tailored to restore skin health, improve texture, and enhance your natural glow. Each service is performed by our experienced aesthetic team with safety and long-term results in mind.

SkinPen® Microneedling

Full Face – $300.00 / Package of 3 – $810.00
Full Face & Neck – $450.00 / Package of 3 – $1215.00

SkinPen is the first FDA-cleared microneedling device, clinically proven to improve the appearance of fine lines, acne scars, and overall skin texture.This collagen-inducing treatment stimulates the skin’s natural healing response for visibly smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking skin.

Chemical Peel with Dermaplane

$125.00 / Package of 3 – $290.00

This advanced treatment combines dermaplaning with a customized chemical peel for enhanced exfoliation and deeper product penetration. Performed by our licensed medical aesthetician, this dual approach reveals brighter, smoother skin with improved clarity and tone.

VI Peel

$300.00 / Package of 3 – $810.00

The VI Peel is a medium-depth, medical-grade chemical peel designed to improve skin tone, texture, and clarity. This advanced formulation addresses fine lines, acne, scarring, hyperpigmentation, and sun damage with minimal downtime. Performed by our licensed medical aesthetician, the VI Peel stimulates collagen production and promotes a brighter, more even complexion with noticeable results after just one treatment.

Dermaplane

$75.00 / Package of 3 – $195.00

Dermaplaning is a manual exfoliation technique that removes dead skin cells and fine vellus hair (peach fuzz). This treatment enhances product absorption, evens skin texture, and leaves the skin with a radiant, polished finish.

Dermaplane, Hydrating Treatment with Red Light Therapy

$125 / Package of 3 – $290

Dermaplaning removes dead skin cells and peach fuzz to reveal a refined complexion. Medical grade hydration follows, softening and plumping for an immediate glow. Red light therapy penetrates beneath the surface to stimulate collagen and accelerate renewal, while a soothing warm hand massage with heated mitts transforms your treatment into a full sensory escape.

HydraFacial™ Treatments

HydraFacial™ is a multi-step, non-invasive facial treatment designed to cleanse, exfoliate, and hydrate the skin using patented Vortex-Fusion technology. Whether you’re seeking a radiant glow, clearer skin, or targeted solutions for fine lines and pigmentation, there’s a HydraFacial experience tailored to your needs:

HydraFacial™ Signature

$175.00

This foundational HydraFacial deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and hydrates the skin using patented Vortex-Fusion technology. Our licensed medical aesthetician personalizes each session to improve skin tone, texture, and overall vibrance.

HydraFacial™ Deluxe

$225.00

Includes all the benefits of the Signature HydraFacial, plus a customized booster serum and LED light therapy. Target fine lines, hyperpigmentation, or congestion with this elevated treatment.

HydraFacial™ Platinum

$250.00

Our most comprehensive HydraFacial experience begins with lymphatic drainage to reduce puffiness and improve circulation. This is followed by a full Deluxe HydraFacial, combining deep cleansing, targeted boosters, and LED light therapy. Perfect for those seeking optimal hydration, rejuvenation, and refinement.

HydraFacial Customized for Acne

$150.00

Deep cleanse, extract, and hydrate with a customized treatment designed to calm breakouts, clear congestion, and minimize pores. Ideal for acne-prone skin

$25.00

Brow Tint

$25.00
